citations.claim: initial total energy before close encounter
energy still near initial one step before violation
first violating step: energy jumped beyond 2% tolerance during deep close approach

explanation: Two 20-mass bodies with G=5 and max dt=1/30 fall toward each other from 1.12 separation to 0.20 separation (below softening 0.3) in 2 steps. Fixed-dt leapfrog with only 21-31 substeps cannot resolve the rapidly varying strong acceleration, so total energy jumps by ~212 (allowed ~197), violating energy_conserved at step 2.
vision_note: Two separate blue bodies visible at step 0 move closer together at step 1. At step 2 they merge into a single overlapping blob, showing a very close approach.
